invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破630（基于ATR 4.81和支撑），或融资费率Z-score回升至-50%以上（空头风险缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 630 (based on ATR 4.81 and support), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short risk eases).

invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.092 (based on ATR 0.0013 and support), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short risk eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2100（基于ATR 22.34和支撑），或融资费率Z-score回升至-20%以上（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2100 (based on ATR 22.34 and support), or funding Z-score rises above -20% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50).
